title: Slayblade
description:
Slay the day away in a run-based battle-tops game from the creator of Nanomon Virtual Pet, Kardboard Kings, and Desert Child. 

Battle your 'blade with SUPREMELY SATISFYING controls! THEN, Spend the Cash you won to buy NEW PARTS! 
 AND THEN, Find INSANE combos with all the parts you Unlock! 
 Features • Build your Slayblade

• Battle your Slayblade

• Bet your lunch money on your Slayblade

• Collect over 60+ parts for your Slayblade

• Break the law with your Slayblade

• Visit a miniature PS1 city with your Slayblade

• Save the city from a rich loser with your Slayblade

✅ What Slayblade IS:

• A snappy experience: Colourful lo-fi visuals, simple/satisfying battles, and fun customization.

• Intuitive gameplay mechanics: The whole game can be played with a Mouse and left-click.

• 2000s vibes: Battling 'blades on the street corner, hand-drawn character art, and amazing music!

• Lots of replay value: Over 60+ Blade Parts to collect, and Loads more Unlockables.

❌ What Slayblade is NOT:

• No big story mode, just a brief intro+Outro cutscene.

• Not a multiplayer game.

 

If you read this far, and you leave a Steam review, somehow use the word "Crumpet". People will be so confused.
description_short: Build your battle-top and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts, Merge their Powers, and Dominate opponents in this Chill Roguelite! Skate around a vibrant Y2K city, winning Cash and Upgrades on your way to the top. And if you Die in the game, you Die in real life.
